report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with a solitary, painless lymph node below the jawline that appeared about a week ago, and increased fatigue for a few weeks. No systemic symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss, easy bruising, bleeding). Family history of CLL (father diagnosed and confirmed). No current prescription medications, occasional ibuprofen, daily multivitamin for 10+ years. Examination reveals a 1 cm mobile, firm but not hard, non-tender lymph node with no other lymphadenopathy or pallor.
